email.fallback_link: If the button does not work, paste this address into your browser:
email.confirm.subject: Confirm your Apivator account
email.confirm.intro: Welcome to Apivator! Click the link below to confirm your account.
email.reset.subject: Apivator password reset
email.reset.intro: We received a request to reset your password. If you did not make this request, you can ignore this email.
email.reset_by_admin.intro: {admin}, an administrator of the {organization} organization, sent you this link so you can reset your password.
email.invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to the {organization} organization on Apivator
email.invitation.intro: {inviter} invited you to the {organization} organization. The invitation is valid for 7 days.
email.invitation.intro_workspace: {inviter} invited you to the {organization} organization and its "{workspace}" workspace. The invitation is valid for 7 days.
email.mention.subject: {actor} mentioned you in a comment: {target}
email.mention.intro: {actor} mentioned you in a comment on "{target}": "{preview}"
email.email_change.subject: Confirm your new Apivator email address
email.email_change.intro: You asked to change the email address of your Apivator account to this one. Click the link below to complete the change. Your old address stays valid until you confirm.
email.email_changed.subject: Your Apivator account email address changed
email.email_changed.intro: The email address of your account was changed to {email}. If you did not make this change, reset your password right away and tell your administrator.
email.password_changed.subject: Your Apivator password changed
email.password_changed.intro: Your account password was changed and your sessions on other devices were signed out. If you did not make this change, reset your password right away.
email.new_device.subject: New sign-in to your Apivator account
email.new_device.intro: Your account was signed in to on {time} from {device}. If this was not you, change your password right away and sign out other sessions.
email.new_device.intro_ip: Your account was signed in to on {time} from {device} (IP: {ip}). If this was not you, change your password right away and sign out other sessions.
email.two_factor.on_intro: Two-step verification was turned on for your account. Keep your backup codes in a safe place.
email.two_factor.off_intro: Two-step verification was turned off for your account. If you did not make this change, change your password right away.
email.sessions_revoked.subject: Your Apivator sessions were signed out
email.sessions_revoked.intro: {admin}, an administrator of the {organization} organization, signed out all sessions of your account. Sign in again to continue.
email.sso_link.subject: Link your Apivator account to SSO
email.sso_link.intro: Someone signed in as "{idpUser}" at the {organization} identity provider and tried to sign in to this Apivator account with SSO on {time}. If this was not you, do NOT open the link; if you confirm, that identity provider account can sign in to this account. If it was you, confirm with the link, then sign in with "Sign in with SSO". The link is valid for 1 hour.
email.sso_link.intro_ip: Someone signed in as "{idpUser}" at the {organization} identity provider and tried to sign in to this Apivator account with SSO on {time} from {ip}. If this was not you, do NOT open the link; if you confirm, that identity provider account can sign in to this account. If it was you, confirm with the link, then sign in with "Sign in with SSO". The link is valid for 1 hour.
email.sso_link.action: It was me, link my account
email.delete_confirm.subject: Confirm deleting your Apivator account
email.delete_confirm.intro: You asked to delete your account. If you confirm, your personal workspace and your data are permanently deleted and you are removed from team workspaces. The link is valid for 24 hours; if you did not make this request, change your password.
email.deleted.subject: Your Apivator account was deleted
email.deleted.intro: Your Apivator account and personal data were deleted. Thank you for using Apivator.
email.monitor.footer: You are receiving this email because your address is in the monitor's notification settings.
